cases.name: normal-hit
cases.note: Hit by 6 (not decisive), skill dmg 6, tempo fails, foe hits through 10% soak (VIT 5 + Defence stance 5)

cases.name: decisive-by-8
cases.note: Win by exactly 8 is decisive: 6 x 1.5 = 9

cases.name: natural-20
cases.note: Natural 20 is decisive even when the margin is under 8 (25 vs 22)

cases.name: natural-1
cases.note: Natural 1 always misses; the foe's defence die is not drawn; no tempo roll after a miss

cases.name: tie-attack-to-player
cases.note: Total 12 vs defence 12: a tie goes to the player

cases.name: tie-evasion-to-player
cases.note: Foe roll 10 vs evasion 10: a tie goes to the player, the blow misses

cases.name: tempo-chain-to-cap-3
cases.note: AGI 25 gives cap 3: attack lands, three tempo wins, three extra actions, the chain stops

cases.name: tempo-lost-stops-chain
cases.note: A lost tempo roll ends the chain after one action

cases.name: tempo-cap-1-low-agi
cases.note: AGI under 15 gives cap 1: one extra action even though the tempo roll could keep winning

cases.name: defence-stance-soak
cases.note: Warrior L15 Defence stance: soak VIT 8 + 3 x 5 = 23%; boss hit 10 -> 7

cases.name: soak-cap-50
cases.note: VIT 30 plus Defence stance 25 = 55%, capped at 50%: boss dmg 22 -> 11

cases.name: soak-min-1
cases.note: A mob hit of 1 against 10% soak still deals 1 (minimum 1)

cases.name: evasion-stance
cases.note: Skirmisher L15 Evasion stance: d20 + 4 + 3 + 2; the 21 ties the foe's 21 and evades (19 would hit)

cases.name: movement-stance-cap-plus-1
cases.note: Skirmisher-Move L15: tempo cap 1 + 1 = 2, tempo roll gets +ceil(3/2); two extra actions

cases.name: area-60
cases.note: Skirmisher-area L15 vs two foes: area costs 2 SP, rolled per target, 60% of 10 = 6; one hit, one miss, tempo rolled once

cases.name: heal
cases.note: Healer L15 heals the ally below half HP: WIS 14 / 3 + mastery 3 = 7, 2 MP

cases.name: heal-clamps-at-max
cases.note: Heal never passes max HP: ally 2/7 healed by 7 ends at 7

cases.name: flee-fails
cases.note: Flee 5 vs the strongest foe roll 16: the exchange is wasted and the foe attacks

cases.name: flee-succeeds
cases.note: Flee 17 vs 14: the party gets away, the fight ends

cases.name: flee-tie-to-player
cases.note: Flee 14 vs 14: a tie goes to the player

cases.name: lone-elite-once-per-hero
cases.note: A lone elite attacks once per standing hero (2 heroes, 2 attacks), each at its own turn

cases.name: lone-apex-three-heroes
cases.note: A lone apex attacks once per standing hero (3 attacks); heroes that go down mid-phase are skipped by the target rotation

cases.name: cap-2x-party
cases.note: Four standard foes vs one hero: only 2 x party (2) of them attack

cases.name: foe-decisive-by-8
cases.note: Foe roll beats evasion by exactly 8: decisive, 3 x 1.5 = 4, through 10% soak = 3

cases.name: foe-natural-20
cases.note: A foe natural 20 is decisive under 8 margin

cases.name: foes-act-first
cases.note: Foe initiative 10 beats the party's 3: the foe phase runs before the party's

cases.name: order-tie-to-party
cases.note: Party initiative 5 ties the foe's 5: the party goes first

cases.name: order-tie-higher-agi
cases.note: Equal initiative 12: the hero with the higher AGI acts first

cases.name: normal-attack-no-sp
cases.note: With 0 SP the hero falls back to the normal attack (STR / 2 = 5) and runs no stance

cases.name: hero-down-loss
cases.note: A hero at 1 HP hit by the foe goes down: the fight ends as a loss

cases.name: focus-lowest-hp-five-foes
cases.note: Five foes with different HP: each action goes to the lowest-HP standing foe (first in order on a tie); a decisive hit kills it and a won tempo roll moves the next action to the next lowest

cases.name: tempo-retargets-across-four-foes
cases.note: Skirmisher L50 (AGI under 25, tempo cap 2) vs four weak foes: a kill, a won tempo roll, the next action on the next lowest foe, twice; the cap stops the chain with the fourth foe still standing, and it attacks alone

cases.name: six-foes-all-attack-three-heroes
cases.note: Six foes act first against three heroes: 2 x party = 6, so all six attack, targets rotating through the heroes in party order

cases.name: six-foes-cap-four-vs-two-heroes
cases.note: Six foes vs two heroes: the cap 2 x party = 4, so only the first four foes in order attack
